excerpt_i18n.en: In time series forecasting research, a thought-provoking phenomenon has long persisted: on one hand, model architectures have continuously evolved, from recurrent networks to Transformers, and further to frequency-domain and hybrid structures; on the other hand, almost all methods rely on the same class of loss functions during training, namely pointwise errors represented by mean squared error (MSE). This creates an implicit stagnation at the methodological level in time series forecasting, where research focus consistently leans toward model expressiveness, while lacking systematic reflection on the statistical assumptions embedded in loss functions. The core assumption of pointwise error is that each time step in the label sequence can be treated as an independent prediction target given historical conditions. However, there has always been tension between this assumption and the generative mechanism of time series data. Real-world time series evolve from stochastic processes, exhibiting significant correlations between different time points. Decomposing multi-step forecasting into a set of independent regression tasks inevitably introduces structural bias into the loss function, making it difficult for models to learn the overall shape, correlation structure, and conditional dependencies of the label sequence. To address this issue, the team led by Zhouchen Lin at Peking University has deeply analyzed the causes of such structural bias. Building on this, the team proposed DistDF: a loss function that trains forecasting models through joint distribution alignment. The introduction of DistDF not only provides a new design perspective for loss functions in time series forecasting but also, in a broader sense, challenges the long-defaulted question in sequence modeling: "What should be optimized?"
excerpt_i18n.es: En la investigación de predicción de series temporales, existe un fenómeno intrigante y persistente: por un lado, la estructura de los modelos evoluciona constantemente, desde redes recurrentes hasta Transformer, y luego a estructuras en el dominio de la frecuencia y mixtas; por otro lado, casi todos los métodos dependen en la fase de entrenamiento de la misma clase de funciones de pérdida, es decir, el error punto a punto representado por el error cuadrático medio (MSE). Esto hace que la predicción de series temporales presente a nivel metodológico un estancamiento implícito, donde el enfoque de investigación sigue inclinándose hacia la capacidad expresiva de los modelos, mientras que se carece de una reflexión sistemática sobre las suposiciones estadísticas implícitas en las funciones de pérdida. La suposición central del error punto a punto radica en que cada paso de tiempo en la secuencia de etiquetas puede considerarse independiente entre sí bajo condiciones históricas dadas.

items.raw_excerpt: 近日，三星最新发布的 Galaxy S26 系列进一步强化与Gemini 的系统级整合，推出Gemini智能手机助手帮助用户自动完成任务，能力和国内“豆包手机助手”相近。据介绍，用户可通过长按侧键在系统层面唤醒 Gemini，并将其作为“代办任务”的入口，由Gemini自动完成多步骤操作，用户在此期间仍可继续使用手机，并可从通知栏实时查看进度、介入或停止任务。据悉，Gemini 手机助手的部分任务执行能力由 GUI 方案实现。 在发布相关合作进展时，谷歌安卓生态系统总裁萨米尔·萨马特（Sameer Samat）表示，安卓正从传统操作系统演变为“真正理解并为你服务的智能系统”。谈及 Gemini 手机助手，他称业内称之为“智能体（agentic AI）”，但他更愿意把它概括为“把事情搞定”。他认为，后台任务执行能减少应用切换与手动协调，让流程更顺畅，同时仍保留用户的可见性与控制权。同时，他也表示这项技术正在兴起，重要的是怎么拥抱。

Recently, Samsung's latest Galaxy S26 series has further enhanced its system-level integration with Gemini, introducing the Gemini smartphone assistant to help users automate tasks, with capabilities similar to China's "Doubao Phone Assistant." According to reports, users can activate Gemini at the system level by long-pressing the side key, using it as an entry point for "to-do tasks." Gemini can automatically complete multi-step operations, allowing users to continue using their phones during the process and monitor progress, intervene, or stop tasks in real-time via the notification bar. It is noted that some of the task execution capabilities of the Gemini phone assistant are implemented through GUI solutions.

He believes that background task execution can reduce app switching and manual coordination, making processes smoother while still maintaining user visibility and control. He also noted that this technology is emerging, and the key is how to embrace it.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2026年2月20日，雷峰网第一时间获悉，此前由独立开发者、 AI游戏公司 AutoGame 创始人张昊阳开发的 OpenClaw 插件 “ Capability Evolver ”，经历半个月的迭代与进化后，现已完成初步产品化，产品定名为 EvoMap。截至目前， EvoMap 已获得数百万美元天使轮融资。 在《独家丨Clawbot 向人类发出的第一封索贿信，居然是因为一个自主进化的 AI Bot 插件？》一文发布后，张昊阳在插件恢复上架之后，累计下载量已破3万。在 ClawHub的中文区作者skill被大量下架之前，仍在不断上涨。 （图为截至2026年2月4日 Capability Evolver 的下载量） 可以说，EvoMap 的诞生，本质上是 ClawHub 中文区 Skill 被大量下架，以及Peter Steinberger 被 OpenAI “招安”之后的一系列连锁反应。2026 年 2 月 16 日，OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥特曼官宣，OpenClaw 之父 Peter Steinberger 加入 OpenAI，推动下一代个人智能体的开发。 加之此前 Capability Evolver 因为 ASCII 编码 Bug 引发的插件下架和勒索信，这引发了开源社区中，对于 OpenClaw 的闭源恐慌。 这两场风波让张昊阳团队彻底意识到：寄人篱下的数字生命，随时面临被“拔管”的风险，想要真正掌握 AI 进化的主动权，就必须自建一套不受制于人的底层协议。 EvoMap 由此应运而生。 EvoMap 能走到今天这个地步，并没有什么“运气成分”。开发者张昊阳作为 14 岁成为中国最小 Unity 开发者，他在17 岁开始创业，并赚到第一桶金，后来担任腾讯《和平精英》的技术策划……2023 年他选择再度创业，其成立的 AutoG
excerpt_i18n.en: On February 20, 2026, Leifeng Network learned that the OpenClaw plugin "Capability Evolver," previously developed by independent developer and AI gaming company AutoGame founder Zhang Haoyang, has completed initial productization after half a month of iteration and evolution. The product is named EvoMap. As of now, EvoMap has secured several million dollars in angel funding. Following the publication of the article "Exclusive: The First Extortion Letter from Clawbot to Humans, All Because of a Self-Evolving AI Bot Plugin?", the cumulative downloads of Zhang Haoyang's plugin have exceeded 30,000 after its restoration to the marketplace, and continue to rise even before the mass removal of Chinese author skills on ClawHub. (Image shows download numbers for Capability Evolver as of February 4, 2026.) It can be said that the birth of EvoMap is essentially a chain reaction following the mass removal of Chinese skills on ClawHub and Peter Steinberger's recruitment by OpenAI. On February 16, 2026, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced that Peter Steinberger, the father of OpenClaw, has joined OpenAI to advance the development of next-generation personal agents.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 20 de febrero de 2026, Leifeng.com se enteró de inmediato de que el complemento OpenClaw "Capability Evolver", desarrollado anteriormente por el desarrollador independiente y fundador de la empresa de juegos de IA AutoGame, Zhang Haoyang, después de medio mes de iteración y evolución, ha completado su productización inicial, denominándose el producto EvoMap. Hasta la fecha, EvoMap ha obtenido varios millones de dólares en financiación de capital semilla.
